user.title: AwoX / EGLO account
user.description: Sign in once with the account you use in the AwoX HomeControl or EGLO Connect app. It is only used to download the mesh credentials and the list of your lamps; the lamps are then controlled locally over Bluetooth. Your account password is not stored.

reauth_confirm.title: Sign in again
reauth_confirm.description: The lamps no longer accept the stored mesh credentials (for example after re-pairing them in the app). Sign in again to download the current ones.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the AwoX cloud. Try again later.
error.no_devices: No Bluetooth mesh devices were found in this account.

abort.already_configured: This mesh is already set up.

menu_options.add_device: Add a device by MAC address

preferred.title: Entry lamp
preferred.description: Home Assistant connects to one lamp and reaches all others through the mesh. By default it picks the one with the best signal.

rated_watts.title: Rated power of the lamps
rated_watts.description: Power of each lamp at full brightness in watts (see the packaging). Used for the estimated power and energy; the plug measures itself.

add_device.title: Add a device
add_device.description: For a device that is missing from the account list. The mesh ID is shown in the app or in the logs.

error.already_added: This device is already part of the integration.
error.other_mesh: This device belongs to a different mesh or is not supported.
